dimensions.assessment: Affects land management agencies, regional utility providers, local recreationists, hunters, and military personnel in Arizona.
dimensions.evidence: reserved for use by the Secretary of the Army for the purposes specified in Public Land Order No. 848

dimensions.assessment: Withdraws public land from mining, entry, and mineral leasing, while granting the Army management or consent authority over specific tracts and utility rights-of-way.
dimensions.evidence: withdrawn from--all forms of entry, appropriation, and disposal under the public land laws

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative management responsibilities for federal public lands without specifying direct federal appropriations.
Amends the Military Land Withdrawals Act of 2013 to add a new subtitle for the Yuma Proving Ground, specifying land descriptions, management rules, and utility corridors.
dimensions.evidence: The Military Land Withdrawals Act of 2013 (title XXIX of Public Law 113-66; 127 Stat. 1025) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Remains in effect for an indefinite period until the Secretary of the Army determines there is no longer a military need.
dimensions.evidence: The withdrawal and reservation of public land made by section 2999B shall be in effect for--an indefinite period

missing_information: Estimated administrative costs for transferring or managing the withdrawn lands.
importance_detail.rationale: Withdraws and reserves approximately 22,032 acres of public land in Arizona for military use by the Army at the Yuma Proving Ground, while allowing specific nondefense uses, utility corridors, and resource management.
